lines.en: label iospringbathhousegen:
scene iospringbathhousegen
I head to the bathhouse to spend some time with Io and, instead, get coerced into taking off all of my clothes.
lines.zh: 我去澡堂想陪 Io 待一会儿，结果反倒被哄着把衣服全脱了。

lines.en: if iosex == False and iospring2 == True:
And while the temptation to pull her into the water with me threatens to derail this monologue, I've already told both myself and her that I would be better than this.
lines.zh: 虽然想把她一起拉进水里的冲动几乎要搅乱我这番独白，但我已经对自己、也对她说过，我会做得比这更好。

lines.en: At least for Io...Because I know where Io comes from. And I know that forcing anyone to do anything isn't as justifiable as I may want it to be.
lines.zh: 至少对 Io 是这样……因为我知道 Io 的来处。我也知道，强迫任何人做任何事，都不像我自己所希望的那样说得通。

lines.en: With so many chips already present in her porcelain skin, I could shatter her with one touch.
lines.zh: 她瓷一般的皮肤上已经有了那么多缺口，我只要轻轻一碰就能让她碎掉。

lines.en: So my hands remain at my sides while my mind drowns in the gutter.
lines.zh: 于是我的手始终垂在身侧，而我的思绪却沉进了阴沟里。

lines.en: It's a compromise I'm willing to make.
lines.zh: 这是我愿意做出的妥协。

lines.en: else:
I hope to one day be able to coerce her into taking hers off as well. But she's broken in a way dissimilar to me, so I'm not sure how long that will take.
lines.zh: 我希望有一天也能哄着她把自己身上的脱掉。但她坏掉的方式和我不一样，所以我不确定那要花多久。

lines.en: I suppose that, if worse comes to worst, I can always assist her. She's no stranger to overmedicating, of course.
lines.zh: 我想，实在不行的话，我总还能帮她一把。她本来就不陌生于过量服药。

lines.en: And out of all the medicinal cocktails out there, I'm sure there's bound to be one that will heighten her libido.
lines.zh: 而在那么多药物鸡尾酒里，我敢肯定总有一种能让她性欲高涨。

lines.en: If there is, she probably knows it. But something about the way her eyes move when I talk about sex tells me she'd rather just be unconscious instead.
lines.zh: 如果真有，她大概也知道。但我一提到性，她眼神游移的样子总让我觉得，她宁可就这么昏过去算了。

lines.en: Sometimes, I feel the same.
scene black
I close my eyes and begin to doze off as Io starts explaining the rules of baseball to me. But what I discover is not rest.
lines.zh: Io 开始给我讲棒球规则，我闭上眼睛打起瞌睡。但我找到的并不是安眠。

lines.en: It's that baseball has a lot of fucking rules and most of them don't make any sense.
lines.zh: 而是——棒球他妈的规则多得要命，而且大部分都说不通。

lines.en: Eventually, I manage to drown out her voice with unfinished dreams of a life in which she's in here with me.
lines.zh: 最后，我总算用那些未完的梦把她的声音压了下去——梦里她和我一起泡在这里。

lines.en: And I finally reach nirvana when I dream of a life in which I'm in her.
lines.zh: 而当我梦见自己进入她体内的人生时，我终于抵达了涅槃。

lines.zh: Io 的好感度提升到了 [io_love]!
